description: A sampler that plays a folder of audio files as radio stations: the knob picks a file, and every file runs on while unheard, so tuning to one drops you wherever it has reached.

params.text: Chooses which file of the loaded bank plays, the travel divided evenly among however many there are.
Sets where in the file playback restarts from, as a fraction of its length; with Pitch Mode on it sets the playback speed instead, over eight octaves centred on the middle of the travel.
Restarts the file from the point the START knob sets; in bank select mode it steps to the next bank instead.

inputs.text: Adds to the STATION knob at a fifth of the knob's travel per volt, so 5V covers the whole bank.
Adds to the START knob at a fifth of its travel per volt; with Pitch Mode on that works out at 1.6 octaves per volt, not the 1V per octave the source comment claims.
A rising edge restarts the file from the point the START knob sets.

outputs.text: The playing file, scaled so its loudest sample reaches 5V; with Stereo Output enabled it carries two channels on one cable.

notes: The module plays nothing until a root directory is picked from the right-click menu. That folder's audio files are the first bank and each subfolder is another, up to 16 and 2GB each.
All four lamps blinking slowly means files are being read into memory; all four blinking fast means a file could not be read.
In bank select mode the four lamps read the bank number as binary and the RESET button steps through the banks; leaving the mode loads the one you stopped on.
Only .wav and .raw files are read unless All files allowed is on; a .raw file is taken as headerless 16-bit PCM at 44.1kHz.
menu: Root Directory — opens a folder chooser and rescans; the chosen folder is the first bank and its subfolders are the rest
Enter Bank Select Mode — hands the RESET button and the four lamps over to picking a bank, and the item then reads Exit Bank Select Mode, which loads it
Clear Current Bank — unloads the bank that is playing and stops the sound
Stereo Output enabled — sends a stereo file out as two channels on one polyphonic cable and a mono file as the same signal on both; off, a stereo file is summed to one
Pitch Mode enabled — turns the START knob and its input into a playback speed spanning eight octaves rather than a start point
Looping enabled — starts a file again when it reaches its end; it is on when the module is added
Crossfade enabled — fades between the old file and the new one over about 25ms rather than cutting; it is on when the module is added
Files sorted — reads the files of a bank in name order rather than the order the folder hands back
All files allowed — reads every file in the folder rather than only those ending .wav or .raw

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.2:
